source: PMID:27792326, doi:10.1021/acs.est.6b03705 (Pseudomonas sp. BIOMIG1); project curator
notes: qxyA / oxyBAC. N-dealkylation removes the biocidal activity of benzalkonium chloride, the disinfectant. The qxyAR operon is carried on IS1380 or Tn3 composite transposons in bacteria from wastewater, rivers, soil, hospitals and blood. Benzalkonium chloride is a mixture of alkyl chain lengths; the C12 member is drawn. Reaction chemistry is the same C-N+ cleavage as the carnitine enzyme CntA, which is why its profile places it in group 5.
